rules.name: App Repackaging Detection
rules.description: Android and iOS specific attack detection: app repackaging, certificate pinning bypass, API tampering
rules.query: SELECT "siem_mobile_security_mobile_security_097", "data__json.message" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'OciLoggingService' AND ("data__json.message" LIKE '%app%' OR "data__json.message" LIKE '%repackaging%') AND "value" > 0
